purpose: Teach: 四季/蛇/蝶/鶴/鐘/線路/頂上/聖堂

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 山の頂上まで、線路沿いに登るルートあるって。
lines.en: There's a route that goes right along the train tracks all the way to the summit.
lines.style: Bright, forward-leaning energy. Quick opening beat. Pace picks up as she shares the discovery. Slight lilt of excitement at the end — she's been waiting to tell him this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おっ。途中に古い聖堂もあるらしい。
lines.en: Oh, yeah? And there's an old chapel somewhere along the way, apparently.
lines.style: Quiet interest — not trying too hard. Lean-in moment on the detail. Slow, thoughtful delivery. The tone of someone building a picture with her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 四季の景色が美しい場所だって、雑誌に載ってた。
lines.en: A magazine featured it — the scenery changes completely with each season.
lines.style: Words tumble a little faster now. Genuine enthusiasm, not performing. Slight breathiness on the beautiful part. She's painting the picture for him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: Fair warning though — you'll want to watch for snakes if we go in summer.
lines.style: Grounded, practical tone cuts through gently. Light touch — not scary, just factual. The voice of someone who's actually thought this through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Oh, and apparently there are tons of different butterfly species up there.
lines.style: Bounces back to brightness. Quick, almost conversational rhythm. The 'and by the way' quality of someone who's done her homework and enjoys sharing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 山頂に鐘があって、鳴らせるとか。
lines.en: There's a bell at the top and you can actually ring it.
lines.style: Softens here — testing his reaction. Wondering if he thinks that's cool or silly. Gentle curiosity underneath the statement. A slight pause before the ending.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 鶴の絵の絵馬も、奉納できるよ。
lines.en: And you can offer crane-painted wooden plaques too — ema.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Slightly softer than before. Drawing a line under the possibility of it all. The tone of someone hoping he'll say yes.
